comparisons.peer_topic: Other income net decrease due to lower invested balance
comparisons.peer_summary: Other income, net decreased to $406 million in fiscal year 2024 from $512 million in 2023, primarily due to lower interest income resulting from a lower invested balance.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies discuss 'other' components of their non-operating income/expense. Intel reports a $560 million benefit in 'other, net' from interest related to an EC competition matter. Broadcom also discloses 'other income, net', though it attributes its decrease primarily to lower interest income from a lower invested balance rather than specific one-off litigation benefits. Both address the composition of these 'other' financial line items.

sentences.text: In 2024, we also received and recognized $560 million as a benefit to other, net for interest in relation to the European Commission competition matter for which we recorded and paid a ruling amount to the European Commission in 2009 and that we were successful at challenging and overturning with the ruling amount refunded to us in 2022.
The decrease was primarily due to lower interest income as a result of a lower invested balance.
